title: Launching my first complete game!
author: soloh4cker
selftext:
I have at least 30 android games using AI but most of the games were not even close to identify as "Game". Those were all completely AI slops and flops so I never finished any projects or published. Just kept them to myself!

But now I have finally understood, how to use AI properly to make games! So this is my first project which I think is worth to publish! Now of course this is entierly made using AI (ChatGPT only). Human involvement present only in AI prompts and testing the game! 

Also it might remind you of one NES game you might have played when you were kids because thats where the original concept comes from! It was one of my favorite game of all time and played a lot! Let me know which game does it remind you of and also what do you think about the game! 😁  
[https://soloh4cker.itch.io/berrybound](https://soloh4cker.itch.io/berrybound)

comments.author: StoneCypher
comments.body: please consider quadrupling his moving speed

replies.author: soloh4cker
replies.body: Do you mean only the main hero or all characters? Because if do only hero then he might be too fast then others. He is already a bit faster then others!

replies.author: Ebonyks
replies.body: Either/or. Doesn't really matter, i'm not that poster and have the exact same feedback of the game being horribly slow for movement.

replies.author: soloh4cker
replies.body: Understood. I will try to adjust the speed a bit and see how does it look! Thanks for the feedback.

replies.author: Ebonyks
replies.body: Additional frames in the running animation of the main character would also enhance the look of your game. Good luck!

replies.body: the hero moves at a speed that i find painful

replies.author: soloh4cker
replies.body: Understood. Thanks for the feedback. I will try to adjust the speed of characters!

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body:
cool

good luck with your game

replies.author: soloh4cker
replies.body: It was a really good feedback. Thank you. I made the speed 1.4 times of original and now the gameplay feels good. I updated the published version too.

comments.author: Reign2294
comments.body: I don't mean to be harsh... but I think this will be helpful for you. This game still looks like a webgame made in the early 2000s. If that is your look, great. But players nowadays, even in phone games, are looking for a lot more polish. The idea is that with AI either you create something that mechanically is super fun despite its simplicity, or you spend a hell of a lot of time iterating with the top models to strive to create something comparable to a AA mobile game.

replies.author: soloh4cker
replies.body: I appreciate your honest feedback. Yes actually I wanted to have my game that early 20s feel. Original game concept comes from my one of the favorite NES game I used to play when I was kid so I just wanted to give that game a new look. And also this was my learning project and finished project. So now I'll be making games with current era. Thanks again for the feedback bro. 🙌🏻
